summary.text: Jeffrey Kerr is the Democratic candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Hillsborough 2, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Kerr also ran in the Hillsborough 2 general elections in 2022 and 2024 but was not among the seven winners, and Ballotpedia lists a bachelor's degree from the Florida Institute of Technology (1986).
